name: web-black-and-white-glowing-arch-hero-with-water-reflection
title: Monochrome hero with a glowing white arch reflected in rippled water and a glass CTA
whatItIs: A black hero with a huge glowing white arch whose lower ends dissolve into horizontal ripples. Centred inside are a thin light-weight headline 'Clarity Emerges From Connection', a grey paragraph, a glowing glass 'Start Your Journey' button and a faded logo strip at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Calm, majestic and meditative; an arch and reflection suggest a gateway.
techniques: Use one glowing geometric arch as the entire visual.
Stretch its base into water-like ripples.
Set light thin headline type inside the arch.
Make the CTA a glowing glass pill.

vocabulary.definition: A bright curved band used as a portal.
